_comment: Ultimate Trifecta authoritative catalogue (V6). One source for previews, ownership, Shop, Season Pass, saves, networking and the service. Item IDs are stable and never reused: runner items are '<Cosmetics field>:<Cosmetics key>' (the same strings the save's owned list has used since V3), profile cosmetics 'card:<key>' / 'badge:<key>', coin packs 'coins:<n>', Season premium 'season:<id>:premium'. Pass 8: a Coin item with "rotation": true is sold only through a scheduled offer (the "offers" section: offer_id separate from the permanent item_id). Real-money prices are never stored here: the Shop shows StoreKit's localized price. The service copy (service/src/catalogue_data.js) is generated from this file by service/tools/sync_catalogue.mjs and a test fails if they differ.

items.name: Season 1 · After Hours Premium
items.blurb: Unlocks the Premium track of Season 1 · After Hours for this season, permanently. Every Premium reward you have already earned becomes claimable at once. It never changes speed, reach, stealth or score, it isn't a subscription, and it doesn't skip tiers.

s1.name: After Hours
s1._dates: Season dates are server UTC and deliberately unset for this beta: no countdown is shown and purchased access never expires. Earned and claimed rewards are permanent.

offers._comment: Pass 8 rotating Shop offers. GENERATED by tools/make_offer_schedule.py from 'rule' and the items with "rotation": true: edit the rule (or the pool), bump schedule_revision, run the tool, then node service/tools/sync_catalogue.mjs. An offer (offer_id) sells one permanent item (item_id) for its Coin price between starts_at_utc (inclusive) and ends_at_utc (exclusive), judged by the game service's clock at the moment it accepts the purchase. Ownership never expires; a skin can return under a new offer_id.

economy._comment: Centralised earning values (client projection and service settlement read the same numbers). Coins and Season XP come only from eligible, service-verified online rounds; practice settles nothing into the wallet or the pass. Purchased Coins never become XP.

challenges._comment: Pass 8: daily and weekly goals that add Season XP to the existing pass (no other currency, no boost, nothing to buy, no claim button). Progress comes only from eligible, service-verified, completed online rounds the player actively played (active_s: seconds of real input or objective play counted by the host's simulation; a round is active when active_s >= min(active.min_s, active.min_share x round time)). A round belongs to the UTC day (00:00 UTC) and week (Monday 00:00 UTC) of its registered start and can settle into that period until grace_s after the period ends. Contribution credits: each unique required-water stamp or each different runner tagged, at most credit_cap_per_round a round. Bonus XP is added in the round's settlement, once per player and challenge instance.
